text: It was wonderful experience at Hotel Saikrupa hotel, the reception staff Sheikh Mam had assisted all the way from booking to room availability. Rooms are clean and spacious. Good for family and group booking. Only 5 minutes walking from Mandir and Main Market. Ample parking available. All the staff is was very helpful. Do consider visiting.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Great Hotel with Excellent Service in Shirdi!

We had a very pleasant stay at Hotel Saikrupa, Shirdi. The rooms were comfortable, clean, and well-maintained, making it a great choice for families and pilgrims visiting Sai Baba Temple.

The hotel staff were friendly, helpful, and cooperative throughout our stay. Their hospitality and willingness to support guests made our experience smooth and enjoyable. The overall service and comfort were very good, offering excellent value for money.

I would definitely recommend Hotel Saikrupa, Shirdi, to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay during their Shirdi visit.

Thank you to the entire team for your wonderful hospitality. Keep up the great work! 🙏

Highly recommended — 5 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
